mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_message (session_id, user_id, role, content, tool_name, tool_payload, token_count, status, create_time) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{toolName}, #{toolPayload}, #{tokenCount}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, content, tool_name, tool_payload, token_count, status, create_time FROM agent_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, content, tool_name, tool_payload, token_count, status, create_time FROM agent_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND role IN ('USER', 'ASSISTANT') AND content IS NOT NULL AND content <> '' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 1
